description: This Python script is designed to analyze and summarize usage costs of models in the CodexBar system, either from local JSON logs or via external CLI commands. It provides command-line options to display current model costs or aggregates of all models, supporting JSON and text formats.

classes.description: Data class representing a model and its associated cost.

methods.description: Aggregates model costs from entries, summing costs per model.
